_comment: TEMPLATE — copy this file to 'settings.json' at C:\WorkCapture\settings.json, then set 'machineDefaultClientCode' to THIS VM's client code (e.g. QTP, ETG, TIER3, SDV). That is the ONLY field you change per machine; everything else is identical fleet-wide. 'apiKey' is intentionally blank — the ingestion endpoints don't require it. Unknown keys like this _comment are ignored by the agent.
